Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, palmoplantar keratoderma and woolly hair define Naxos disease; vertigo does not establish ear damage.

Localized cutaneous amyloid deposition with lichenification and pruritus in 16/16; systemic organ involvement is not part of this condition.
Congenital skeletal myopathy; ophthalmoplegia causes persistent ocular motor dysfunction in 4/11. Feeding difficulty alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Autoimmune adrenal failure with thyroid and/or islet disease defines APS2; celiac disease, alopecia and vitiligo are separately diagnosed associated disorders.
Inherited organic acid metabolism disorders; lasting neurodevelopmental injury affects over 30% across the major clinical forms, despite some benign subtypes.
Skeletal dystrophy with an O-glycosylation disorder; restrictive ventilation in 2/4 reflects muscle weakness and does not establish intrinsic pulmonary damage.
The concept explicitly identifies infantile neurologic disease and bone fragility; unspecified multisystem involvement cannot establish additional axes.
Neurodevelopmental disease; limb shortening 80-99%; persistent vision defects occur in over 30% overall. Singleton cardiac/renal reports do not establish common involvement.
Autosomal recessive retinal dystrophy directly affects the retina; neurological ancestry does not establish extraocular nervous-system disease.
